_comment: Copy to ~/.config/cortados/api-credit.json on the provider's machine (#114). Lists the Anthropic API promotional credit grants exactly as the Console shows them, plus the organisation's monthly spend limit. Never the key (the key stays in the provider's environment, CORTADOS_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). Times are ISO 8601 WITH a UTC offset. remaining_usd + remaining_as_of: what the Console showed left, and when; spend this ledger records from that UTC day on is subtracted. After the last grant expires the lane is off until a new grant is added here. stop_fraction may only be lowered (owner rule: hard stop at 95%). prefer_within_days: S1-routed local-eligible work goes to the API while a grant expires within this many days.
